notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP (requests + curl_cffi chrome124 impersonation) blocked - robots.txt and homepage both returned 403 Cloudflare 'Just a moment' managed-challenge pages. Tier (b) Playwright (headless, then headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled) also blocked by the same Cloudflare challenge even after 12s wait + reload. Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (real logged Chrome profile) which cleared the Cloudflare challenge automatically after a few seconds; all category research done via tier (c). robots.txt content could still not be read even via tier (c) (it repeatedly re-triggered the Cloudflare challenge and never resolved), but actual site content pages loaded normally and showed no bot-block notice, so research proceeded per rule 1(c)/2 (block only stops the specific request path, not the whole tier). TREE: Union of mega-menu top-nav (Rugs, Furniture, Lighting, Textiles, Wall Decor, Accents, Outdoor, New, Top Sellers, Collaborations, Surya Spaces, Clearance) plus each catalog page's own sub-nav strip (Rugs>{Ready to Ship,New,Top Sellers,Custom,One of a Kind,Rug Pads,Racks and Displays,Clearance,All}; Textiles>{...,Pillows,Poufs,Outdoor,Throws,Bedding,Inserts,...}; Outdoor>{...,Rugs,Furniture,Lighting,Pillows,Poufs,Garden Stools,Umbrellas,Umbrella Bases,Made to Order,...}; Wall Decor>{Wall Mirror,Floor Mirrors,Art and Accents,Wall Hangings,...}; Accents>{Vases,Decorative Objects,Planters,...}; Furniture>{Sofas and Lounges,Sectionals,Accent Chairs,Ottomans,Coffee/End/Console Tables,Cabinets & Sideboards,Bookcases,Benches & Stools,Dining Furniture,Bedroom Furniture,Outdoor Furniture,...}). h1/title confirmed to match requested slug on every leaf recorded. QTY: exact 'N Items' header text rendered on each category listing page (confirmed via get_page_text/find after full hydration - some pages render the count a couple seconds after the product grid). No qty was estimated or paginated-and-counted. EXCLUDED (neither Textile nor Storage): Ready to Ship/New/Top Sellers/Clearance/All under every catalog (cross-cutting merchandising filters, not real subcategories, matches banned View-All/Collection pattern); Rugs>Custom (redirects to /CustomRugs, a promotional made-to-order service page with no product count, not a listing page); Rugs>Rug Pads (felted/grip underlayment pads - hardware/accessory, not a textile floor covering itself, not storage); Rugs>Racks and Displays (Design Center/Design Gallery/Gliding Rug Rack/Pillow Tower/Rug Display Rack - trade/retail showroom merchandising fixtures, not consumer storage or textile product); Wall Decor>Wall Hangings (Surya's wall-hanging line reads as mixed-media/rigid panel product - 1in depth on the one product checked - no confirmed fabric/tapestry material; site places it under the separate Wall-Decor catalog not Textiles, so kept out per textile.md S14 default); Wall Mirror/Floor Mirrors/Art and Accents (Wall Decor, not textile); Accents>Vases/Decorative Objects/Planters (purely decorative, no storage function, matches storage.md S24 exclusion); Furniture>Cabinets & Sideboards/Bookcases/Ottomans/Benches & Stools (site explicitly places these under its own Furniture catalog - storage.md S21/S27 says prefer Furniture when the site's own hierarchy does, already covered by Furniture.xlsx); Lighting catalog not visited (out of scope, no textile/storage possibility). Dropped Textiles>Outdoor (649 items, a combined Pillows+Poufs bucket) in favor of the more granular Outdoor>Rugs/Outdoor>Pillows/Outdoor>Poufs nodes to avoid double-counting the same outdoor pillow/pouf SKUs under two sibling category trees (kept the deepest/most specific valid subcategory per textile.md S25). Poufs (Textiles>Poufs qty 242, Outdoor>Poufs qty 29) marked MEDIUM confidence / review-queue: Surya's Poufs are small (~14inH x 18inW x 18inD) fabric floor poufs sold under the site's Textiles/Outdoor catalogs (not its Furniture catalog's Ottomans line), which is a genuine Textile-vs-Furniture boundary case per textile.md S21; included as Textile on website-hierarchy grounds. Storage: no Storage, Organization, Storage Baskets/Boxes/Bins, or Organizer category or products found anywhere in the mega-menu, sub-navs, or Accents catalog - Surya is a rug/textile/lighting/furniture manufacturer with no home-organization product line, so storage_rows is correctly empty (NO_CATEGORY).
